warm_threads_this_week.title: Existing alt text - exclude words
warm_threads_this_week.status: STRONGEST LEAD LOGGED TO DATE. User asked for a way to stop the AI overwriting hand-written alt text; the vendor shipped a protect-words field in 2.6.0 that silently did nothing, and a bulk run overwrote their protected alt texts - they stopped the run after ~200 images and had to restore them by hand. On 2026-08-28 they wrote 'If you could improve the mentioned prompt... I could use this plugin furtherly', i.e. they are not currently using it. Vendor replied to update to 2.7.0. This is a live, unconverted user whose exact complaint is our core differentiator (nothing saved without review and approval). Also independently told the vendor that not being tested against current WP hurts adoption.
